body.statement:
Let a consistent minimum-distance estimator be interior with probability tending to one.  If its moment residual is continuously differentiable near the truth, its moment Jacobian \(J\) has full column rank, its fixed weight \(W\) is positive definite, and the empirical moment vector has limit covariance \(\Sigma\), then
\[
\sqrt n(\widehat\theta-\theta_0)\Rightarrow
\mathcal N\!\left(0,
(J^{\mathsf T}WJ)^{-1}J^{\mathsf T}W\Sigma WJ
(J^{\mathsf T}WJ)^{-1}\right).
\]

attestation.note: The node is the fixed-weight minimum-distance specialization of Theorem 3.2.
